tool: Agent OS MCM Helper config generator

invocation.transport: typed intent -> upstream-schema-validated config.json + deterministic settings.ini

human_checks: localized wording and UI layout density remain human-facing presentation checks

coverage.description: Validates MCM Helper JSON against a compatibility-normalized pinned upstream schema, then cross-checks ModSetting IDs/defaults, type prefixes, group controls and common numeric option invariants.
known_gaps: runtime Papyrus actions and property-backed values still require script/runtime validation
localization string-table completeness is validated separately
coverage.denominator_probe: report counts all pages, controls, ModSetting-backed controls, settings defaults and group-condition references

safety.sandbox_or_scope: Writes only under generated Data/MCM/Config/<modName> plus an optional report.

verification.version_probe: Pinned upstream MCM Helper config schema and MIT license under third_party/mcm-helper
verification.output_readback: Generated JSON/INI derive from the same validated intent and report all resolved ModSetting IDs.

ai.context_cost_notes: Models author compact typed intent; renderer owns schema quirks and INI synchronization.

evidence.notes: Upstream SettingStore confirms defaults live in Data/MCM/Config/<modName>/settings.ini and setting IDs are key:section; CommonLib Setting type derives from leading setting-name character.
